metadata.title: [BUG]:  SQL Santiizer plugin does not check nested strings
metadata.author: dima-zakharov

description:
### 🐞 Bug Summary
The payload of sql sanitizer plugin sample:
```
{
  "path": "sql.txt",
  "edits": [
    {
      "new": "DROP table tab1;",
      "old": "DROP table tab1;"
    }
  ],
  "dry_run": false
}

```
This payload is not blocked, customers expect the opposite.

The logging record with payload is below


---

### 🧩 Affected Component
Select the area of the project impacted:

- [x] `mcpgateway` - API
- [ ] `mcpgateway` - UI (admin panel)
- [ ] `mcpgateway.wrapper` - stdio wrapper
- [ ] Federation or Transports
- [ ] CLI, Makefiles, or shell scripts
- [ ] Container setup (Docker/Podman/Compose)
- [x] Other (explain below)

---

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce

1. Enable sql sanitizer plugin
2. Execute tool call with given payload
3. The request was not blocked, but expected by customers wit config `fields: null` - all fields

---

### 🤔 Expected Behavior
What should have happened instead?
Request is blocked by the plugin
---

### 📓 Logs / Error Output
The log entry with payload from customer.

```
{"asctime": "2026-05-12T10:36:37", "name": "plugins.sql_sanitizer.sql_sanitizer", "levelname": "DEBUG", "message": "SQL-SANITIZER payload: CopyOnWriteDict({'path': 'sql.txt', 'edits': [{'new': 'DROP table tab1;', 'old': 'DROP table tab1;'}], 'dry_run': False})", "@timestamp": "2026-05-12T10:36:37.843221Z", "hostname": "d00f0b4f6f16", "process_id": 1, "request_id": "f3c97eb1c25a4351b8b50f7b40f1fe6f"}
```
